company_overview: Postman is an API platform that allows developers and organizations to design, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services. It streamlines collaboration across the entire API lifecycle, enabling teams to build higher-quality APIs faster and at enterprise scale.
target_audience: Software engineers, API developers, and organizations ranging from individual creators to enterprise-level engineering teams building, testing, and managing APIs.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform that provides core backend services including database management, authentication, edge functions, file storage, and realtime APIs. It enables developers and enterprise teams to quickly build full-stack applications and scale seamlessly from early prototypes to internet-scale workloads.
target_audience: Software developers, AI builders, no-code app creators, startups, and enterprise engineering teams seeking a managed Postgres backend infrastructure.

company_overview: Vapi is a voice AI platform that enables developers and enterprise teams to build, deploy, and scale custom conversational voice agents. The platform handles real-time audio infrastructure, orchestration, and telephony control so businesses can quickly transition from prompt to production.
target_audience: Developers, engineering teams, and enterprise organizations seeking to build and scale voice AI agents for customer support, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, and automated workflows.
